versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud CodeArts Pipeline & Build Diagnosis skill.
- Provides management, monitoring, and automated failure diagnosis for CodeArts Pipeline (流水线) and CodeArts Build (构建任务) via the hcloud KooCLI.
- Supports listing, detail query, build log retrieval, error extraction, root cause identification, and anomaly diagnosis.
- Enables pipeline/build-task creation, starting, and deletion with safety preview and confirmation.
- Integrated triggers for both Chinese and English DevOps terminology.
- Authentication supports both AK/SK and local hcloud profiles; all actions honor IAM permissions and project/regional scoping.
